name: Measuring relay
summary: A measuring relay responds to a measured electrical quantity and issues an output according to its configuration.
description: A measuring relay responds to a measured electrical quantity and issues an output according to its configuration. Measurement inputs, auxiliary supply and output contacts may be separate terminal groups.
readingNotes: Identify the measured quantity before tracing the output contact logic.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A measuring relay is not simply a coil powered by the same quantity it measures.
